mentions.note: Strong Q3 beat with 4% same-store sales growth, and 70% of cash flow from Canada and international. Long-term investors are rewarded, and short-term trading risks missing the next run.
Burger King winning; better company than McDonald's; better positioned for current environment and consumer dynamics.

Burger King crushing at 8.6% US/Canada comps (beat 6.2%), +13% adj op income; but Tim Hortons 0.1% comps (missed), Popeyes down 5.1%. Stock at 18x forward; Patrick Doyle turnaround in progress despite parent dragging it down.
Shares are rangebound below $81-82 resistance; a confirmed breakout above that level could open the door to triple digits, per Lang.
